coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Commons
record.summary: A roughly two-acre lawn and green space at 450 Mission Bay Boulevard South in Mission Bay (per SF Rec & Park's facility page), part of the city's Mission Bay Parks system; the San Francisco Recreation and Park Department assumed management and maintenance on July 1, 2023 (SF Rec & Park). OCII's November 14, 2024 timeline gives opening years for the eastern Commons segments (P16 in 2010, P17 in 2002), but which of the two is this lawn is not confirmed, so no opening date is stated for it.

notes.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project. These are expected dates, not events, and the sources differ: SF Rec & Park's project page gives an estimated schedule of design mid-2026, construction beginning late 2028 and opening to the public early 2030, yet the same page says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update lists 'Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)'. No source reconciles the 2028 and early-2030 completion dates.

milestones.text: Park P16 opens -- one of the completed eastern segments (P16 and P17) of the Mission Bay Commons strip in OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update legend, labelled "Completed" at the east end of the strip on its map; which of the two this record's mapped lawn is, is not confirmed. OCII's November 14, 2024 timeline says "P16 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2010)" (and "1st Mission Bay parks open ... at Mission Bay Commons P17 (2002)"). An EPA media advisory dated November 4, 2011 (an announcement of a tour, not an opening) calls P16 "another recently completed Mission Bay park" and "the newest segment of the Mission Bay Commons Park system", funded partly by a DTSC brownfields grant

open_questions: Dated events found: SF Rec & Park's July 1, 2023 assumption of management from OCII (a management transfer, not a construction-completion date, so not used as a completion milestone), and the opening years in OCII's November 14, 2024 timeline (P16 in 2010, P17 in 2002; see the milestone). Which of P16 and P17 is this lawn is not confirmed, so no opening date is stated for the lawn itself.

As of 2026-09-22, OCII's own Nov 2024 CAC map places labels P16 and P17 specifically at the east end of the Mission Bay Commons strip, matching this record's own mapped lawn -- resolving which OCII labels apply here, versus the P11/P12/P13/P15 labels used for the separate, still-interim area further west (the Mission Bay Commons, Parcels P12, P13 and P15 record). The only dated source found (a Nov 2011 EPA press release) names just P16, not P17, and says the park was "recently completed" rather than giving a construction date or a dedication date -- so the milestone above is deliberately narrower than that OCII grouping might suggest.

The Future Parks Project that will rebuild the interim western parcels has expected dates that differ: SF Rec & Park's project page gives construction beginning late 2028 and opening to the public early 2030, yet also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028', and OCII's November 14, 2024 update lists 'Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)'. All three are expected dates, not events.

The EPA release (2011-11-04) is a media advisory for a tour, names P16 only and has no location; the opening years (P16 2010, P17 2002) come from slide 9 of OCII's Nov 14, 2024 deck, whose timeline lists them, and the location of P16 and P17 comes from that deck's legend. This record's mapped shape leaves the P-number unconfirmed, so the milestone is stated about the eastern Commons segments, not this exact lawn.
